description: This file contains shared utility functions to generate deterministic colors and map statuses to specific color themes, primarily for use in UI elements on dark backgrounds. It exports functions to generate consistent pastel colors from strings and to map statuses like 'processing', 'success', 'failed', or 'unknown' to theme-specific colors.

methods.name: colorFromString(key, { saturation = 55, lightness = 55 } = {})
methods.description: Generates a deterministic pastel-oriented HSL color string based on an input string, ensuring distinct hues for different inputs while maintaining readability on dark backgrounds.

methods.name: getStatusColor(status, oc)
methods.description: Maps a given status string to a theme-specific color (like primary, success, or error). Uses predefined mappings for common statuses, falling back to a deterministic color for unknown or custom statuses.
